items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve; signed Jaleel McLaughlin from practice squad.
items.why: Official IR placement after knee injury in W1.
items.implication: Clears path for Judkins/Sanders committee; Judkins low routes noted separately but now primary.
items.opportunity: Increased RB snaps/routes for remaining Browns backs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey day-to-day with rib injury (Harbaugh); left game but produced. Beneficiary Tre Harris for waivers if sits.
items.why: Rib issue post W1; monitored, efficiency drop without him noted.
items.implication: Game-time risk Week 2; handcuff/add Harris if available. Downgrade if limited.
items.opportunity: If out, WR snaps/routes open in McDaniel offense.

items.text: Week 2 injury beneficiaries for waivers: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs etc. Streamers include Kendre Miller, Deebo, Devaughn Vele.
items.why: Precise mapping of injured stars to available backups with role expansion potential.
items.implication: Prioritize Miller/Deebo/Harris-types on waivers; FAAB accordingly for immediate and stash value.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. Same left knee that had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year; scary history but optimistic short-term.
items.why: Coach/reports indicate realistic W2 return chance post trim; prior knee issues elevate risk.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer benefits short-term if delayed. Stash Bowers firmly.
items.opportunity: TE1 role awaits return; Mayer interim volume.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week.
items.why: FFHH endorsement amid Stribling injury opening SF WR role; familiar Shanahan system.
items.implication: Priority add for WR depth/flex; immediate starter potential.
items.opportunity: Expanded routes/targets with Stribling out; multi-purpose usage.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) listed in early W2 injury report as out/injured for waiver purposes; Kendre Miller primary beneficiary and streaming RB option.
items.why: ETR waiver injury mapping and Levitan W1 notes confirm absence impact.
items.implication: Miller worth FAAB/stream; Etienne still shares but elevated overall.
items.opportunity: Miller snaps/routes/carries expand; Etienne committee remains.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9, 2.5 last night; just 2 targets (7% share) but ran 29 of 33 Mahomes routes (behind only Worthy 30). Needs serious volume to produce; routes present.
items.why: Low aDOT and target share despite near-max routes; box-score reliant on volume that may not materialize with Walker dominating touches.
items.implication: Volatile WR3/flex; monitor target share ROS as Walker workhorse may suppress short-area looks.
items.opportunity: 29 routes / 33 dropbacks but only 2 targets; aDOT collapse.
items.conflict: High routes vs low targets/volume need

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush, 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated RB opps early and throughout; high route/target share confirms three-down role.
items.implication: Elite RB1 every-week starter with massive opportunity share in Mahomes offense.
items.opportunity: 29/32 RB opps, 19 routes, 6 targets, goal-line/short-yardage implied by TD work.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7/7 targets. Sole RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Looked healthy; strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line monopoly and route edge over Gainwell despite modest overall volume; health confirmed.
items.implication: Solid RB2/flex with TD upside and pass-game role; start confidently Week 2.
items.opportunity: Only inside-10 RB carry; 21 routes vs Gainwell 13; 7 targets.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53-26-15 Etienne-Miller-Donaldson; routes 24-5-7; opps 18-9-4. Surprised by committee share.
items.why: Even without Kamara, Miller and Donaldson ate into snaps/routes/opps more than expected.
items.implication: ETN more RB2 than locked RB1; Miller handcuff/waiver priority if Kamara misses more.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game since ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), team-high 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy; encouraging ramp.
items.why: High route/target share in limited snaps post major knee injury; healthy exit.
items.implication: WR1 upside returning; volume should grow as snap share rises.

items.text: Team-by-Team show live: unexpected usage, injury fallouts, coach tendencies from W1. Highlights Walker eruption, Nabers return, Shough fire; implications for ROS.
items.why: Deep dive on W1 tape/usage with Evansilva for rest-of-season adjustments.
items.implication: Informs ROS rankings and trade values; free content for opportunity-based views.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Limited pass-game involvement despite Sampson injury; committee with Sanders.
items.implication: Judkins more pure runner; lower PPR floor. Sampson IR boosts him somewhat but routes lag.
items.opportunity: 13 routes post-Sampson exit; Sanders matched routes.

items.text: Lions offense ultra-concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Extreme target/carry concentration on the big four leaves zero secondary roles.
items.implication: Start all four with extreme confidence; fade any Lions depth pieces.
items.opportunity: 93% of all offensive opportunities to core four.
